structured.reason: The description contains statements that address the reviewers' complaints about difficulty and unclear instructions in a minimizing or caveated way, which the criterion treats as negative. Offending phrases: (1) "Basic instructions come in the packaging to help you get started." This answers the reviews' complaint that the instructions are tiny, minimal, or "worthless," in a defensive way. (2) "Practice a few styles and build your skills at your own pace." This implies the product requires practice and skill-building before it works well, which is a caveat about performance and matches the "with some practice" hedge the criterion names. (3) "New to updos? ... to help you get started." This reassurance for beginners responds to the difficulty complaints ("Too difficult to use with minimal instruction"), so it is minimizing rather than a pure positive. The remaining copy (specs, colour options, "Everything You Need in One Set") is neutral or positive, but the negative signals above are enough to fail under the strict standard.
